label: About
title: About The Edge Outlasts the Day
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1213 recent saved-signal files and 309 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Edge of the Disc: Ambient Music Found on Forgotten CDs (1988–2006) and Flying Saucer Attack & Roy Montgomery – Goodbye / And Goodbye / The Whole Day (1997, EP), plus 7 more. A source image from i.ytimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Edge Outlasts the Day: Optical twilight as product-photo rupture, seen in a low oblique optical-edge view: an enormous tilted arc exits right and bottom, exposing a translucent underside and displaced shadow beneath a broad pale upper field. A narrow burnt-orange face interrupts the left edge. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Stepped cutout exposing silver skin and transparent bevel, Dark elongated lower-field interruption with an abraded upper lip, and Localized blue diffraction streak.
